labels.name: legitimate_transaction_alert
labels.definition: Automated notifications from banks, payment apps, telecoms, or merchants informing the user of an actual account activity such as a debit, credit, OTP, balance update, or bill due, sent through official channels without asking the user to click suspicious links or reveal credentials.
examples_of_edge_cases: Your A/c XX1234 debited INR 2,500 on 12-Jun-24 via UPI. Avl bal INR 8,320. Not you? Call 1800-XXX-XXXX.
OTP for txn of Rs.4999 at Amazon is 738291. Valid for 10 mins. Do not share with anyone.
Your electricity bill of Rs.1,240 is due on 15th. Pay via official app to avoid late fee.
Dear customer your credit card statement is generated, total due Rs.15,342, min due Rs.800.

labels.name: phishing_attempt
labels.definition: Deceptive messages impersonating banks, government bodies, delivery services, or other trusted entities that try to trick the recipient into clicking malicious links, sharing OTPs/PINs/passwords, or making payments to fraudulent accounts.
examples_of_edge_cases: Dear User your ATM card will be blocked today. Click http://bit.ly/verify-now to update KYC immediately.
Your parcel is held at customs, pay Rs.50 clearance fee here: tinyurl.com/fake-post to release it.
SBI Alert: Your account is suspended due to suspicious activity. Verify at sbi-secure-login.net within 24hrs.
Congratulations you have won Rs.25,00,000 in KBC lottery, share your bank details to claim prize.

labels.name: promotional_spam
labels.definition: Unsolicited marketing or advertising messages from businesses, telecom operators, or bulk senders promoting sales, offers, subscriptions, or services, with no personalized transaction data and no credential-harvesting intent.
examples_of_edge_cases: Flat 70% OFF on all styles! Shop now at Myntra, use code SAVE70. T&C apply.
Recharge your number with Rs.199 plan and get 2GB extra data daily. Offer ends soon!
Get pre-approved personal loan up to 5 lakh at low interest, apply now via our app!
Your favorite restaurant has a special weekend combo just for you, order now on Swiggy.

labels.name: personal_message
labels.definition: Messages exchanged between individuals for personal, social, or informal purposes such as chatting, making plans, sharing news, or casual conversation, not generated by automated business or fraud systems.
examples_of_edge_cases: hey are we still meeting at 7 for dinner or should i come later?
mom said dont forget to bring the charger when u come home this weekend
lol did u see what happened in class today, tell u later
Can you send me the notes from yesterday's lecture pls, I missed it

generation_personas: A 60-year-old retired schoolteacher in a small town who uses a basic keypad phone, writes in full sentences with occasional typos, and is easily worried by anything mentioning bank account problems.
A 19-year-old college student who texts in heavy shorthand and abbreviations, mixing English with local slang, mostly chatting with friends about classes and parties.
A small business owner who frequently receives and sends payment confirmation texts via UPI apps, comfortable with financial jargon and numeric transaction codes.
A scam operator crafting urgent, typo-laden phishing messages designed to impersonate banks and government agencies, using shortened links and fake caller IDs.
A marketing intern at a telecom company drafting bulk promotional SMS blasts with emojis, discount codes, and urgency phrases like 'limited time offer'.
A middle-aged parent juggling work and family, texting kids about pickup times, groceries, and reminders in short, practical messages with minimal punctuation.
A non-native English speaker recently immigrated, who writes texts with translated phrasing and occasional grammatical errors, often receiving bank and government notifications.
A tech-savvy young professional who quickly skims and deletes spam, texts friends in witty one-liners, and occasionally forwards suspicious messages to family to warn them.
An elderly widow living alone who relies on her grandson to explain unfamiliar texts, writes very short replies, and often mistakes phishing attempts for real bank alerts.
A gig economy delivery driver who gets frequent automated app notifications about payments, ratings, and customer messages, often reading texts quickly while multitasking.
